scope: Negotiated TextEditorEdit.setEndOfLine and ordered native EOL/text history/mirrors; whole stable API and seamless personal migration remain required.

source_cohort.selection: git ls-files --cached --others --exclude-standard; unique existing files, sorted UTF-8 relative paths
source_cohort.digest_algorithm: sha256(concatenate(path UTF-8 + NUL + raw sha256(file bytes)))

items: Negotiated public EOL builders enforce enum, last-request, original-source and lifetime contracts before dispatch
Native EOL precedes text and acknowledgement with original-version FIFO, normalization and correct Undo/Redo boundaries
One actual worker retains bounded intent/capacity and stale edit-Undo replies preserve original work and Redo
Shared inactive views retain logical line-end carets and reversed selections; EOL-only and same-EOL behavior retain native identity/history
Complete native/host regressions, unchanged upstream controls, actual terminal integrity and required style checks retain source evidence

qualification_conditions: Eight new library cases cover prepared EOL/history (6), actual worker occupancy with edit-Undo ABA (1), and real framed receipt order/invalid-last-frame refusal (1). Three new public host/App integrations cover ordered mixed edits, EOL-only/same-EOL and a later plain editor edit refusing the original version instead of overtaking EOL.
Four new host cases cover negotiated capability, enum/last-request/lifetime capture, no optimistic EOL updates, EOL-only dispatch and refusal before partial native text work.

Seventeen actual terminal scenarios run on the final production binary: editor set EOL (2), Undo stops (2), existing EOL normalization (1), Position replacement (1), snippets (4), decorations (2), workspace edits/EOL (1) and native language configuration (4).

EOL conversion and replacement normalization reuse the existing bounded workspace Rope worker helpers; allocation-prepared native bodies and source-owned snippet history are retained. One EOL worker admits eight intents including actual work, 8 MiB of retained payload and a five-second lifetime. Public ordinary edits queue behind an occupied EOL operation so original versions determine outcome.

The complete final source digest is verified unchanged after the final native/host/terminal/style pipeline. Original model/view/language/resource/save/history and owner/session proofs authorize publication. The real worker remains occupied after sending its result until its thread actually exits.

The batch sends up to two ordinary state notifications and the ACK through one bounded transport queue admission before infallible native publication. This qualifies their order and no supported-prefix admission; exact incremental/EOL contentChanges payloads and arbitrary transport/backend behavior remain unqualified.
Native editing without Node is exercised by the four installed native language-configuration journeys; no personal extension code is activated. No new release archive, tag or publication is created.

The preceding 525edcc complete main CI passes Linux/Windows, host/native on all three platforms, and the new editor Undo journeys on macOS. macOS fails later at an ambiguous picker-readiness assertion. Separate test commit 0f91020 requires the actual versioned picker before disabling. Fresh exact-head three-platform results remain required.

failed_observations_retained.observed: The initial EOL/native-typing unit case produces basePA\r\nB instead of basePAB\r\n: ordinary replacement mapping moves a line-end caret beyond the converted newline.
failed_observations_retained.repair: Mark EOL position changes to preserve the start boundary in forward and inverse native view mapping. All four history pairs and an inactive/shared reversed-selection regression pass; existing workspace conversion shares the correction.

failed_observations_retained.observed: macOS native_configuration_pty.py waits for Disabled fixture.native after its generic Installed Extensions readiness marker. The retained screen shows the initial installed list and catalog-ready header. The generic marker can also match the command palette before the picker.
failed_observations_retained.repair: Use the same versioned-row/controls and absent-palette/loading checks already used for Delete before sending the disable key. Keep the disable receipt, persisted preference, generated-owner retirement, exact disk/history and no-code-execution assertions. Four local journeys pass. The initial suspicion of a catalog-status message overwrite was not established by source inspection.
